rome-tuscany-val-d-orcia-sweep.title: Rome · Tuscany Val d’Orcia Sweep
rome-tuscany-val-d-orcia-sweep.slogan: A 365 km loop out of Orvieto coffee
rome-tuscany-val-d-orcia-sweep.story: Cypress hills, stone towns and golden light. Out of Orvieto and back again: 365 km, roughly 6 h 18 in the saddle. On the way it passes Pienza ridge roads, Val d’Orcia cypress road and Montalcino. It keeps to quiet secondary roads.

sections.advice: This Pienza ridge roads → Val d’Orcia cypress road stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Val d’Orcia cypress road → Montalcino food is the reward section in Rome. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

scenicChapters.narrative: 27 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Romantische Strasse
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 22 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

It crosses from Austria into Germany - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules.

legend-quebrada-de-las-conchas.story: curated scenic road. red canyon, rock formations, wine country. A one-way ride of 161 km, Salta to Cafayate - roughly 2 h 56 in the saddle. scenicChapters.title: Quebrada de las Conchas
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 28 km this is Quebrada de las Conchas, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
